intervention.target: K+ channels (BaCl2); dopamine receptor agonist / serotonin receptor antagonist (monoaminergic signalling)
intervention.timing: co-exposure of intact worms from 0 h
intervention.description: Intact worms cultured in 1 mM BaCl2 together with 0.5 uM bromocriptine.

readout.method: visual scoring of anterior tissue / head integrity under dissecting microscope

notes: "other" = head degeneration (anterior tissue degrades / head deprogresses) in intact worms; no amputation. 74% without degeneration at day 2 (text and legend). n not stated. Later timepoint in text: by day 22, 50% no degeneration, 38% degenerated, 9% died. Dose/dose_units refer to bromocriptine; BaCl2 was 1 mM. Bromocriptine itself acts as agonist, not blocker.
